about: station 4 of the video line on the mini (2026-10-19): mini_v2.py --brand --label --out [--dry-run] — the production station's run by the same label (Shared Assets runs/video-production/<brand>/<label>/), taken only when production finished it (production-done.json, every listed clip made); line.py, the one edit path (edit map, lips, render, words, the audit on every version, the card in 1-check), handed on through Shared Assets runs/video-edit/<brand>/<label>/ (run_kit.station) only when the line exits 0. --dry-run plans the edit only (edit_map.py — free, no render). Beside the v1 door (lab_entry.py), not in it.
